reserveReview.rationale: Re-verified on 2026-08-11. Issuer product, token-feature, and legal materials consistently state that each PGOLD represents 1 troy ounce of 99.99% purity physical gold meeting LBMA standards, with KYC-gated physical redemption. VISTO CPA's June 25, 2026 report independently confirms the Arbitrum 19,505-token liability figure and part of the bullion inventory, but physically counts only 50.86% of the claimed bullion, relies on shipping and issuer/insider assertions for the rest, excludes weight, purity, authenticity, and valuation, and does not cover the separate Ethereum native supply. The reserve category remains a single 100% commodity-allocated position; the report does not justify a stronger assurance or custody conclusion.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Report source recovery completed 2026-10-09T11:51:05Z: the token-free June 25, 2026 VISTO report was visually read in a dedicated PDF renderer after static extraction failed. PDF page 2 identifies a Hong Kong store room at Unit 1032, 10/F Block B, Focal Industrial Centre, 21 Man Lok Street, Hung Hom. Appendix A-1 (PDF page 6) reports 50.86% physically stock-taken, 38.9% under shipping and 10.24% held by Pleasing Golden International Limited or its beneficial owners; two segregated storage custodians remain unnamed. Appendix A-3 (PDF page 8) identifies Pleasing Golden International Limited and Pleasing International (HK) Limited as affiliated operational entities under the same ultimate beneficial owner, not independent custody or holder-protection evidence. The signed board resolution asserts segregated storage and no third-party encumbrances, but does not establish enforceable holder segregation, bankruptcy priority or a current whole-book provider allocation. The assurance conclusion concerns point-in-time quantity, excluding gold quality and valuation; no post-June continuity is assured. The governing Terms still describe unspecified custodians and insurance that may not cover all losses. Recovery removes the unreadable-attachment blocker, not the custody-continuity or complete-assurance gaps. Aggregate custodyModel, safeguards, historical composition/report dates and original mechanism C dates remain unchanged.
